title: Haunted ATX Hearse Limo Tour in Austin
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the eerie side of Austin on a unique haunted tour in a classic Cadillac hearse transformed into a spooky limo. Each night, embark on a 3-hour journey to historic locations known for their paranormal activity, including the Clay Pit and Littlefield House at UT. Guests will enjoy minimal walking while getting out frequently to visit haunted establishments. With complimentary sodas and ice available, guests can also bring their own alcoholic beverages to enjoy responsibly. This tour is perfect for ages 13 and up, making it an ideal experience for thrill-seekers and ghost enthusiasts alike.

- Tour operates every night at 7 pm
- Discover haunted hotspots in Austin with frequent stops for exploration
- Enjoy complimentary refreshments; byob if you wish
- Minimum of 2 participants required, accommodating small groups up to 6
